page_section: DOCX; Section: 2.10 Marking, Moderation and External Examiner Approval; paragraph beginning '2.10.2 Once finalised...'
mapped_section: Once finalised, assessment tasks (both for first-sit and reassessments) will be proof-read and checked for fairness and consistency before being forwarded to the relevant External Examiner for comment and approval prior to being published to students. Assessment approvals should be obtained at least 12 weeks before the assessment submission and/or examination date. Any changes required by an External Examiner must be approved by them prior to release to students.

page_section: DOCX; Section: 2.10 Marking, Moderation and External Examiner Approval; paragraph beginning '2.10.8 All marks for summatively...'
mapped_section: All marks for summatively assessed work are subject to approval of the relevant Assessment Board. External Examiners will always be asked to provide confirmation that they approve the marks. If marks are not approved and/or External Examiners do not confirm approval the marks will not be released to students until approval has been confirmed.

page_section: DOCX; Section: 2.2 Key Principles of the Assessment and Feedback Policy; paragraph beginning '2.2.1 The key principles of the Assessment...'
mapped_section: Developmental Feedback should be specific, clear, constructive, relevant, actionable and forward looking. It should support development at both individual and cohort level and the principles outlined in Winstone et al (2016)’ SAGE model to develop in learners: self-appraisal, assessment literacy, goal setting, self-regulation, engagement and motivation. Feedback should be timely and clear minimum standards of feedback should be identified and communicated. (see Section 3 of this Policy)
